summary: Kodi is an entertainment centre application designed to organise and play music, videos, and images. It provides a centralised interface for local media consumption across multiple operating systems, having evolved from its origins as XBMC.
goodFor: Users who want a customisable, local media playback interface for a dedicated living room setup or multi-platform device collection.
watchOut: It functions primarily as a standalone client application rather than a server-first streaming daemon, which can complicate remote web access and multi-device synchronisation.
deployNotes: As a compiled C++ application distributed via native packages, it typically requires local persistent storage for media libraries and configuration files, alongside appropriate audio and video drivers on the host machine.
